verses.text:
Judge me, O
God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; deliver me from the deceitful and unrighteous man.

For thou art the
God of my strength: why hast thou cast me off? why go I about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Send out thy light and thy truth: they shall lead me, they shall bring me to thy holy mount, and unto thy habitations.

Then will I go unto the altar of
God, unto the
God of the gladness of my joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O
God, my
God.

Why art thou cast down, my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in
God; for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my
God.
